Adres: Merkez Mah. Tuna Sok. No:15-17 Kat 1, 34245 Gaziosmanpaşa / İstanbul
Telefon: +90 530 507 88 34
E-posta: arled@arledscreen.com
Web: https://arledscreen.com/tr/
